title: GunnyBot Canonical Policy Document
description: One record per policy document. The canonical store is the single source of truth. 0.2.0 FROZEN 2026-07-09 after pilot and 200-doc gates. 0.2.1 (2026-07-10) is ADDITIVE: uslm_identifier path IDs, verification status, corrections log, edge_meta with cited-vs-inferred basis. 0.4.0 (2026-07-18) is ADDITIVE: sections[].provisions[] carries provision-depth decomposition (one paragraph per node, stored path absolute, displayed label local) per the P-track and Maj Gannon's HHQ requirements - 0.3.0 records remain valid. 0.3.0 (2026-07-18) is BREAKING per owner ruling N0.3 (ndr-conformance-matrix.md): uslm_identifier re-rooted to full command lineage - /us/usmc/* becomes /us/dod/don/usmc/*, /us/navy/* becomes /us/dod/don/*, /us/dod/fmr unchanged. MIGRATION: prefix substitution only, tails unchanged, document ids untouched - consumers holding 0.2.x uslm identifiers apply the two prefix rewrites. Records at 0.2.x remain schema-valid for archival reads; the live store is regenerated wholesale at 0.3.0.

id.description: Stable citation identifier derived from the native document number.

doc_type.description: Issuance type. 0.5.0 added the authority tiers above the service: statute (USC), DoD (DODI, DODD, DODM, DTM, DODREG), joint (CJCSI), executive (EO), and the Navy forms the reference lists actually name (OPNAVINST, BUMEDINST, SECNAVM, SECNAVNOTE, NAVSO). Additive - no existing record changes.

native_number.description: The number as printed on the document, e.g. 001/23 or 5215.1K.

archived.description: When the scraper captured the document

basis.description: cited = the source text states the link. inferred = resolution or hierarchy inference. Never conflate.

edge_meta.description: Annotations for edges in the sibling arrays.

adjudication_ref.description: Row reference into the adjudication worklist

pocs.description: Point-of-contact lines, raw. PII review applies before publication rendering.

anchor.description: Stable within-document citation anchor. Chunk IDs derive as {id}#{anchor}.

number.description: Native paragraph or chapter number as printed, e.g. 5, 0401, IV.

uslm_identifier.description: Anchor-grade path ID: {doc uslm_identifier}/{anchor}. Provision-grade paths await deeper parsing.

provisions.description: Phase P1/P2 - one entry per individual numbered or lettered paragraph, hierarchy explicit. The STORED path is absolute (p8/a/1/b); the DISPLAYED label is local only ((b)), preserving standard naval letter format. Empty when the document is not provision-shaped (tables, flattened extractions, stubs) - absence is an honest answer, never fabricate a tree.

path.description: Relative provision path within its base, e.g. p8/a/1/b. Numbered top-level paragraphs take the pN form; a section opening at a lettered paragraph keeps the bare letter.

number.description: Full citation form as a Marine would write it, e.g. 8.a.(1)(b).

label.description: Local marker exactly as printed, e.g. (b) - the only form shown in print view.

text.description: Paragraph text with the marker stripped.

raw_marker.description: Exact source marker, retained for round-trip fidelity.

citations.description: Phase P3 - provision-grade outbound citations found in this paragraph's text. A citation resolves to chapter and verse, not merely to a document.

text.description: The citation as written in the source.

target_path.description: Provision path in the target. Null when the citation names a document only.

conversion_notes.description: Converter warnings - unparsed dates, missing subjects, fallback paths taken.

uslm_identifier.description: USLM-convention path identifier, e.g. /us/usmc/maradmin/2023/051. Maps 1:1 from id.

verification.description: UNVERIFIED = faithful machine extraction, not confirmed line-by-line against source. VERIFIED = human-confirmed. Promotion only, never silent.

corrections.description: Dated corrections made against source text. The store carries its own error history.

$comment: 0.5.0 (2026-08-03) - doc_type enum widened to the authority tiers above the service. Additive under [VER1]: every 0.4.0 record validates unchanged against 0.5.0. Required to hold the statute and DoD records a top-down authority chain terminates in.
